name: mise
description: The inspected mise self-update verifies the release archive with the repository zipsign key and conditionally checks the macOS binary with codesign; the macOS check can be skipped when codesign is unavailable.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout.
Source does not establish release signing provenance or historical binaries.
The macOS code-signature control is conditional.
